Alex (Support): Escalating — Mosaic trial (tenant: mosaic-trial-42) is stuck in onboarding. Customer can't ingest docs, embeddings return 502s. They hit this during their demo tomorrow; renewal conversation in 9 days. Need CS contact + immediate comms plan. :exclamation:
Mira (CS): On it. I'm taking this as P1 for CS. Can someone paste the error logs + tenant id? I'll book a 30m remediation call within 2 hours. :calendar:
Alex (Support): Tenant ID is mosaic-trial-42. Error snippet: ```
HTTP 502 from /v1/embeddings
{"error":"upstream_read_timeout","request_id":"req_0123abcd"}
Trace: embedding_service -> kv-cache -> backend-504
```
Alex (Support): Also seeing repeated `quota_exceeded` spikes in the support traces right before the 502s. :thinking_face:
Ravi (Eng): Quick triage: looks like transient overload hitting our prefix cache. Two immediate mitigations: 1) Temp quota bump on that tenant (5x) while we patch batching behavior. 2) Route their requests to a lower-latency pool in the same region. I can do the route switch now if we approve. Command to check current quota: `curl -X GET https://api.redwood.ai/tenants/mosaic-trial-42/quota -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"`
Jordan (AM): Customer is running a live demo at 3pm PST. If we don't fix by then this deal goes to risk. They mentioned potential expand if demo goes well. I'll join the call and note renewal touch in 9 days.
Mira (CS): Proposed comms plan: (1) Immediate outreach: email + 10m triage call with Alex + Ravi within 30m. (2) If quick mitigation works, schedule a 30m remediation session with customer and offer a 2-week trial credit for disruption. (3) Update renewal brief for AMs: note mitigation steps + ask for a 1-week grace on SLA. I'll draft the message; Jordan please sign off on credit amount. :memo:
Jordan (AM): OK to offer one 2-week $500 credit and a free enablement session. Please confirm language and I'll approve. :+1:
Alex (Support): Outreach sent to customer at 172.21.10.4 (support thread linked): "We're investigating and will have a remediation next steps call in 20 min." They accepted 2pm slot.
Ravi (Eng): I've applied the temporary route switch and increased tenant quota. Monitoring dashboards show error rate dropping. Will keep the route for 2 hours while we push a fix.
Oncall Bot: Incident update: ticket #INC-2025-772 created; priority=P1; assigned to Mira (CS) and Ravi (Eng).
Mira (CS): I'll lead the call, confirm the workaround, run a short replay of their demo flow, and capture any feature gaps. After call: internal notes + next steps back to Jordan for renewal messaging.
Alex (Support): Customer called out two ask items: SSO onboarding help and a sample ingest script. I'll attach their SSO admin email and request logs.
Mira (CS): Action items: - 1) Run remediation call now (Mira, Alex, Ravi) - 2) Deliver SSO enablement checklist + sample ingest script within 4 hours - 3) Post-call: send credit + remediation summary and schedule 1-week follow-up - 4) Jordan to update renewal brief. I'll update this thread with the call summary.
Jordan (AM): I'll prep the renewal brief and the credit approval doc. If demo salvaged, we'll push for expansion.
Ravi (Eng): Follow-ups: I will: 1) submit PR with batching guard, 2) schedule midnight hotfix window if needed, 3) revert route after stable.
Mira (CS): Call done — workaround held, demo path validated. Customer appreciated the rapid response. Sending remediation email now and CC'ing Jordan. Marking this as mitigated but still high-risk for renewal until next-week follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Support): Thanks team — great response. We'll leave ticket open until follow-up confirmed.
Mira (CS): Internal comm plan summary (to paste into CRM & ops): "Customer experienced ingest 502s due to transient quota/route overload. Temporary quota bump + route change mitigated the issue during the demo. Actions: credit $500 offered, SSO & ingest enablement session scheduled, eng fix queued. Renewal flagged for proactive outreach in 7 days. Contact: Mira (CS) / Jordan (AM)."
Jordan (AM): Acknowledged. I'll reach out to renew in 7 days and include remediation summary. :eyes:
